scope: Resolve PowerPoint 'There was a problem getting the information for your map chart' Bing Maps resolution failure

tasks.title: Fix Map Chart Series Layout & Geography Entity XML Schema
tasks.description: Fix the <cx:chartSpace> definition for map charts in ExtendedChartGenerator.js / ChartCacheGenerator.js. PowerPoint's Bing Maps integration displays 'There was a problem getting the information for your map chart' when entity references or dimension structures are invalid: (1) Ensure <cx:series layoutId='geochart'> defines proper layout properties (<cx:layoutPr><cx:parentLabels/><cx:regionLabel/></cx:layoutPr>), (2) Structure <cx:chartData> with dimension type 'entity' or category text values conforming to ISO alpha-2/3 country codes or standard English geographic names, (3) Link the geographic entity dimension correctly via <cx:strRef> pointing to the workbook sheet and range, (4) Ensure the numeric metric values map strictly as continuous values with an associated <cx:colorScale> containing min/mid/max stops.

tasks.title: Fix Backing Excel Worksheet Structure for Bing Maps Recognition
tasks.description: Align ChartWorkbookUpdater.js for map charts: (1) Ensure Sheet1.xml uses strict 2-column tabular data with explicit row/column headers ('Country' / 'Region' and metric title), (2) Wrap the data inside an official Excel Table element (xl/tables/table1.xml) if required by Office 2016+ map charts with 'Geography' entity type hints, (3) Populate xl/sharedStrings.xml with recognized canonical nation names (e.g. 'United States', 'United Kingdom', 'France', 'India', 'Germany', 'Australia'), (4) Match exact formula coordinates between <cx:formula> in chart XML and the cell ranges in Sheet1.xml.

tasks.title: Implement Pre-Rendered Geographic Shape and Data Cache Fallback
tasks.description: Ensure ExtendedChartGenerator.js provides pre-cached data point values and attributes (<cx:dataPt>, <cx:geoCache>, or cached values inside <cx:lvl>) so PowerPoint does not fail immediately or display a broken offline state when opening without an immediate Bing Maps API round-trip.

tasks.title: Verify testMapChart in showcase/charts_operations.js
tasks.description: Run node showcase/charts_operations.js map using showcase/templates/ChartPowerPointSample.pptx. Open the resulting presentation in Microsoft PowerPoint and confirm that the error banner 'There was a problem getting the information for your map chart' is completely eliminated, data resolves automatically without requiring manual refresh, and geographic boundaries render cleanly.
